# Google Public DNS

https://developers.google.com/speed/public-dns/

IPv4 DNS Server:

8.8.8.8

8.8.4.4

IPv6 DNS Server:

2001:4860:4860::8888

2001:4860:4860::8844

A free, global DNS resolution service that you can use as an alternative to your current DNS provider. In addition to traditional DNS over UDP or TCP, Google also provide DNS-over-HTTPS API. See more in the Google FAQ.

# Cloudflare

Cloudflare

# Cloudflare

https://1.1.1.1/

IPv4 DNS Server:

1.1.1.1

1.0.0.1

IPv6 DNS Server:

2606:4700:4700::1111

2606:4700:4700::1001

1.1.1.1 is a partnership between Cloudflare and APNIC. Cloudflare runs one of the world’s largest, fastest networks. APNIC is a non-profit organization managing IP address allocation for the Asia Pacific and Oceania regions. Cloudflare had the network. APNIC had the IP address (1.1.1.1). Both of us were motivated by a mission to help build a better Internet. You can read more about each organization’s motivations on our respective posts: Cloudflare Blog / APNIC Blog. Visit Cloudflare Community Forum.

# Level 3

Level 3

# Level 3

http://www.level3.com/en/

IPv4 DNS Server:

209.244.0.3

209.244.0.4

The free DNS servers listed above as Level 3 will automatically route to the nearest DNS server operated by Level 3 Communications, the company that provides most of the ISPs in the US their access to the internet backbone. Alternatives include 4.2.2.1, 4.2.2.2, 4.2.2.3, 4.2.2.4, 4.2.2.5, 4.2.2.6. These servers are often given as Verizon DNS servers but that is not technically the case.

# Verisign

Verisign

# Verisign

https://www.verisign.com/en_US/security-services/public-dns/index.xhtml

IPv4 DNS Server:

64.6.64.6

64.6.65.6

IPv6 DNS Server:

Verisign Public DNS is a free DNS service that offers improved DNS stability and security over other alternatives. And, unlike many of the other DNS services out there, Verisign respects your privacy. We will not sell your public DNS data to third parties nor redirect your queries to serve you any ads. See more in the Verisign Public DNS FAQ.

# Quad9

Quad9

# Quad9

https://www.quad9.net/

IPv4 DNS Server:

9.9.9.9

149.112.112.112

IPv6 DNS Server:

2620:fe::fe

2620:fe::9

Quad9 routes your DNS queries through a secure network of servers around the globe. The system uses threat intelligence from more than a dozen of the industry's leading cyber security companies to give a real-time perspective on what websites are safe and what sites are known to include malware or other threats. If the system detects that the site you want to reach is known to be infected, you'll automatically be blocked from entry – keeping your data and computer safe. See more in the Quad9 FAQ.

# Comodo Secure DNS

Comodo Secure DNS

# Comodo Secure DNS

https://www.comodo.com/secure-dns/

IPv4 DNS Server:

8.26.56.26

8.20.247.20

Comodo Secure DNS is a domain name resolution service that resolves your DNS requests through Comodo worldwide network of redundant DNS servers. This can provide a much faster and more reliable Internet browsing experience than using the DNS servers provided by your ISP and does not require any hardware or software installation. When you choose to use Comodo SecureDNS, your computer's network settings will be changed so that all applications that access the internet will use Comodo SecureDNS servers. Comodo Secure DNS gives you a safer, smarter and faster Internet. See more in the Comodo Secure DNS FAQ.

# Norton ConnectSafe

Norton ConnectSafe

# Norton ConnectSafe

https://dns.norton.com/

IPv4 DNS Server:

199.85.126.10

199.85.127.10

Norton ConnectSafe is a free service that provides a first layer of defense by blocking unsafe sites automatically. On a computer, Norton ConnectSafe does not replace the comprehensive protection of a full security product such as Norton Internet Security or Norton 360. Instead, Norton ConnectSafe provides basic browsing protection and content filtering for all Web-enabled devices on your home network. See more in the Norton ConnectSafe FAQ.

# GreenTeamDNS

GreenTeamDNS

# GreenTeamDNS

http://www.greentm.co.uk/

IPv4 DNS Server:

81.218.119.11

209.88.198.133

GreenTeamDNS is a 100% cloud-based cyber security filtering service that protects you from malware and phishing sites and /or unwanted or offensive content – all based on simple filtering policies you set. Making this simple DNS switch on routers (preferred), computers, tablets or mobile devices will allow you, your children or employees to avoid accidental or deliberate exposure to adult content, gambling sites, malware and phishing sites. See more in the GreenTeamDNS FAQ.
